title: Flaky required check: concurrent creates in separate processes serialize
description:
Filed from WCLI-9 on opum-agent's kickoff. The required check on dev is not deterministic: the case "T06: transactions > concurrent creates in separate processes serialize: one wins, one refuses" failed the first Check run of opum-ai/ward-cli#60 and then dev's own push run at 8446ffc, passing on re-run both times, while an identical source tree passed at 7cbd9cc. Two failures in four runs of one tree. It holds a merge until someone re-runs it, so it costs every session that lands work, and a red required context that means nothing is a signal everyone learns to ignore.

Not a WCLI-9 defect: the tree that failed is byte-identical to the tree that passed. The case belongs to WCLI-6's area (encrypted SQLite store, transactional mutation), but it lives in the test suite rather than in that closed task.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The failure is measured and recorded: the exact commits, the runs that failed and passed, the runner, and the failing output captured verbatim at least once -- or the recorded runs show it did not reproduce, with the same detail

The case is deterministic on the required Check context: the change that made it so is named in the notes (the fix, or a quarantine naming the reason and what unblocks it), and no run after it is recorded as failing on this case alone
